user.title: Pixoo64 Setup
user.description: Connect your Divoom Pixoo64 and link it to your Home Assistant media player.

data_description.pixoo_ip: Select your auto-discovered Pixoo64 or enter its local IP address.
data_description.media_player: The speaker, soundbar, or media player whose album art and track details will be displayed.
data_description.temperature_entity: Sensor to display live room or outdoor temperature on the screen overlay.
data_description.tv_mode: Shows a retro TV graphic with color bars when watching TV (HDMI-ARC, Netflix, YouTube) and turns room lights off. If disabled, the screen turns off completely or returns to your clock channel.

manual.title: Manual IP Entry
manual.description: Enter the local IP address of your Pixoo64 device.

data_description.pixoo_ip: The static or DHCP IP assigned to the Pixoo64 on your local network (e.g. 192.168.1.50).

lights.title: Preferences & Ambient Lighting
lights.description: Customize smart on-screen overlays and synchronize your lights with dominant album colors.

data_description.osd_overlay: Pop up sleek, non-intrusive on-screen alerts when you tweak the volume or hit pause.
data_description.pause_timeout: How long the 'PAUSED' screen chills before the display turns off or returns to your clock.
data_description.volume_osd_duration: How many seconds the volume bar stays visible before jumping back to your epic album art.
data_description.light_entity: One or more RGB lights that will dynamically match album art colors in real time.
data_description.wled_ip: Optional IP of a WLED controller to mirror album palettes and dynamic effects.
data_description.only_at_night: Only activate room lighting sync when the sun is below the horizon.

apis.title: Cover Art & AI APIs
apis.description: Configure external services to find missing album art or generate custom AI covers.

data_description.ai_model: AI image model used to generate conceptual album art.
data_description.pollinations_key: Secret key from [Pollinations.ai](https://pollinations.ai). Required to activate the 'Force AI Art' switch on your dashboard. Leave blank to keep existing key, or type 'clear' to remove.
data_description.musicbrainz_enabled: Query the free MusicBrainz database if cover art cannot be retrieved from your player.
data_description.internet_archive_enabled: Query the free Internet Archive database for rare tracks, live concerts, and archival artwork.
data_description.spotify_client_id: Client ID from the [Spotify Developer Dashboard](https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard). Unlocks artist photos and the animated 'Spotify Slider' gallery mode. Clear this field to completely remove Spotify.
data_description.spotify_client_secret: Client Secret from the [Spotify Developer Dashboard](https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard). Leave blank to keep existing secret.
data_description.tidal_client_id: Client ID from the [TIDAL Developer Platform](https://developer.tidal.com) for lossless cover art matching. Clear this field to completely remove TIDAL.
data_description.tidal_client_secret: Client Secret from the [TIDAL Developer Platform](https://developer.tidal.com). Leave blank to keep existing secret.
data_description.lastfm_key: API Key from [Last.fm Accounts](https://www.last.fm/api/account/create) for fallback artwork. Leave blank to keep existing key, or type 'clear' to remove.
data_description.discogs_token: Personal token from [Discogs Developer Settings](https://www.discogs.com/settings/developers) for physical release lookups. Leave blank to keep existing token, or type 'clear' to remove.
data_description.playlist_prefetch_range: Pre-fetches artwork for upcoming and recent tracks in the playing queue (±5 or ±10 songs) into RAM for instant skip transitions. Requires streaming APIs (Spotify, TIDAL, or Discogs). Automatically bypassed during Spotify Slider mode to avoid network and RAM overload.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Pixoo64. Please check the IP address and power.
error.spotify_id_required: Spotify Client Secret was provided without a Client ID.
error.spotify_secret_required: Spotify Client ID was provided without a Client Secret.
error.tidal_id_required: TIDAL Client Secret was provided without a Client ID.
error.tidal_secret_required: TIDAL Client ID was provided without a Client Secret.
